prompt_en: Create a photorealistic Republic of Korea Armed Forces promotional poster featuring the same unmistakably adult woman from the reference portrait as a modern special-warfare operator. Preserve her eye aperture and spacing, long oval face, jaw width, nose, lips, natural skin texture, adult age, and long dark wavy hair. She powers forward through a rain-wet obstacle course, one boot striking a shallow puddle into a sharp arc of spray as her torso leans into the stride toward the next concrete ramp. Her matte helmet, headset, uniform, plate carrier, and pouches move with believable weight; a compact carbine stays controlled across her chest, muzzle angled down. A low 35 mm three-quarter full-body frame uses a boot-to-face diagonal, keeping her identity dominant while the upper sky remains a clean field reserved for later typography. The same sunrise rim light catches her cheek, helmet, spray, and wet armor; rain darkens nylon seams and beads across matte surfaces. Her focused gaze reaches beyond the camera toward the objective. The result reads as premium national-defense recruitment campaign key art: energetic, disciplined, capable, and resolutely forward-moving.

A trusted counterpart and relationship response were not requested and would add a second story.

decisions.rationale: Upper-body framing would hide the boot strike and weaken the requested dynamic full-body read.
Long-exposure smearing would reduce facial fidelity and tactical equipment legibility.
A window silhouette conflicts with the outdoor obstacle-course sunrise.
On-camera flash would replace the coherent campaign sunrise treatment.
An extreme wide view would shrink the reference identity and reduce poster impact.
A walking pose is less forceful than the already locked puddle-impact sprint.
